title: Self-improvement for absolutely Cesáro bounded operators
summary: We prove that every $p$-absolutely Cesàro bounded operator with constant $K>1$ is $q$-absolutely Cesàro bounded for $1\leq q 0$. On $L^p$-spaces, $1<p<\infty$, we extend the implication from absolute Cesàro boundedness to $p$-absolute Cesàro boundedness from positive to individually eventually positive operators. Finally, for every $1\leq p<\infty$, we construct a $p$-absolutely Cesàro bounded operator $T$ on $\ell^1$ such that $σ(T)\subseteq\mathbb D\cup\{1\}$ but $\limsup_{n\to\infty}\|T^n(I-T)\|=\infty$.
